subject.title: WhatsApp: Add support for querying message reactions

question: Should ordinary WhatsApp reactions become passive plugin events only, also enter agent sessions, or additionally be persisted for historical `message reactions` queries?
rationale: Current main proves channel-owned inbound protocol access for approvals, but broader exposure changes the plugin API, session behavior, privacy boundary, and persistent-state ownership.

options.title: Passive events first
options.body: Emit typed add/remove events from the existing WhatsApp socket without starting agent runs, and separately design historical storage.

options.title: Full events and queries
options.body: Add passive events plus SQLite-backed historical lookup through the generic `reactions` action.

options.title: Approval-only scope
options.body: Keep inbound reaction consumption restricted to native approval controls and decline broader reaction-read support.

recommendation.title: Passive events first
recommendation.body: Emit typed add/remove events from the existing WhatsApp socket without starting agent runs, and separately design historical storage.

likelyOwner.reason: This person introduced the current channel-owned approval reaction path and is the strongest available owner for choosing how it should generalize.
